verdict.rationale: Asking whether a managed media relay service can be operated by natural-language commands is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows the dashboard and a REST API, plus a platform-wide llms.txt and an OpenAPI spec. Those are developer building blocks and host-platform documentation, not a natural-language interface the product itself provides, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
